If you are visiting the Ozona area and looking to get out on the water, you are in exactly the right place. Ozona is one of Tampa Bay’s most charming waterfront communities, sitting right along St. Joseph Sound with direct access to some of the Gulf Coast’s best boating destinations.Marker 26 Boat Rental is right here in Ozona at Island Harbor Marina on Orange Street N. services.desc: Skip boat ownership and join the Marker 26 Boat Club, a locally owned membership based at Island Harbor Marina in Palm Harbor, FL. Unlimited pontoon access to Clearwater Beach, Honeymoon Island, Caladesi Island, and Three Rooker Sandbar, one monthly fee, zero hassle. Big franchise boat clubs have a dirty little secret: they sell far more memberships than their boats can handle. You pay thousands upfront, sign a long-term contract, and then spend your summer refreshing a reservation app hoping a Saturday opens up. Marker 26 was built to be the opposite. Marker 26 serves Palm Harbor, Dunedin, and Clearwater with a clean, well-maintained fleet of pontoons and tri-toons. Marker 26 Boat Club and Rental gives you fast, easy access to Honeymoon Island, Caladesi Island, Three Rooker, Anclote Key, and more! Every Marker 26 boat is fully inspected and outfitted with Coast Guard-approved safety gear before every rental. Life jackets, fire extinguishers, and navigation lights are all included.
